text: A narrow laboratory aisle viewed lengthwise. The left half is dominated by a large pale panel/wall with dark clamp blocks along its lower edge. In the centre foreground, a white benchtop carries a black rectangular instrument housing mounted on grey aluminium posts with silver screws; behind it stands a capped tube or bottle with an orange-red cap, upright. Further back are white boxed enclosures, a white tray or basin, black equipment with a dark cable, a blue unit, and a rack of vertical pipettes or columns against a white cabinet. At right, extruded aluminium rails and a black post, plus a green-capped container upright on a shelf. Overhead, a long fluorescent strip light, ceiling ducts and hangers; a bright window at the far left.
